Fluffy Pancakes

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 2 tbsp sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1 3/4 cups milk
- 2 eggs

Instructions:
Whisk the dry ingredients together in a large bowl.

Beat the milk and eggs, then stir into the dry ingredients until just combined.

Cook on a hot greased griddle until golden on both sides.
